rows.text: You sit before the manual service desk of Time Agency Bank. Looking through the water tank, you see a petite teller in front of a processor, changing their skin color and describing the general account opening process.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Just to confirm, you will be depositing a one-hundred standard hour deposit and the Time Agency Bank will pay your interest at a rate of two percent in five rotations' time. If this is correct, please complete verification according to the account opening process."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You nod, reach out your hands and your fingers meet the teller's tentacles through the screen as you complete one identity verification after another.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "In order to ensure the safety of your account, please set a secondary security question and complete operations on the screen."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

"Configuration complete. This bank has prepared a gift for customers who activate this service for the first time. Please go to the front desk window and use your debit card to retrieve your reward." The tentacle reaches forward to give you a bank card enclosed in a waterproof envelope.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Thank you for your support of Time Agency Bank. Always remember: Time is money."
